name: Hypocrites
overview: Scripture condemns hypocrisy as empty ritualism that God despises, demonstrated by the people’s sacrifices and religious observances which He calls an abomination and iniquity, as seen in Isaiah 1:11-15. Their outward acts of worship, such as fasting and prayer, are rejected because they are accompanied by injustice and insincerity, showing that God values genuine obedience over mere appearance, as highlighted in Isaiah 58:3.
